qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Statutory natural monopoly owning and operating high-voltage electricity transmission networks in England and Wales, plus regulated electricity/gas distribution in NY and MA. Concession revenues are formula-indexed to inflation (RIIO-T2 CPIH pass-through) with regulatory asset base growth, though returns on capital are legally capped at 5-7% nominal.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (gate_6 = N, REJECT). Monopoly electricity transmission grid in England and Wales with regulated US distribution networks, but structurally fails the fortress balance sheet and self-funded cash generation standard. Massive £60B decarbonization grid capex program creates structural cash deficits (FY2025 capex of £10.58B vs OCF of £7.83B), requiring perpetual capital market dependence. Net debt of £42.1B represents 12.9x net income (£3.24B), interest coverage is tight at 3.53x EBIT/interest, and management was forced to execute a dilutive £7.0B rights issue in 2024.
qualitative.evidence: Reported 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 5.66%, constrained by Ofgem RIIO regulatory allowances. Capital expenditures of £10.58B in FY2025 exceed operating cash flows of £7.83B, producing negative owner free cash flow after total capex. Net debt of £42.1B is 12.9x net income of £3.24B (far exceeding the 4.0x threshold), while EBIT interest coverage is 3.53x (below the 5.0x floor). Reliance on continuous debt issuance and a £7.0B equity rights issue violates Buffett's principle of balance sheet independence from the kindness of strangers.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
